A.

run data_prep_sept1.qmd

make sure github saves this

write_csv(raw_data_cleaned , "data/cleaned/over_8_cleaned.csv") 

so that when the next file pulls "data/cleaned/over_8_cleaned.csv" it is the most recent

B. 

then run variable_prep_script_sept1.qmd

make sure github saves this

write_csv(raw_data_cleaned, "data/cleaned/coded_data__09_18_26.csv")

so that when the next file pulls "data/cleaned/coded_data__09_18_26.csv" it is the most recent

C.

then run outcome_variables_sept1.rmd

make sure github saves 

write_csv(raw_data_cleaned, "data/cleaned/all_vars_over_8.csv")

so that when the next file pulls "datadata/cleaned/all_vars_over_8.csv" it is the most recent


D. 

then run Data_Junction.Rmd

make sure github saves 


write_csv(data_full, "data/cleaned_control_data.csv") and 
write_csv(df_no_control, "data/cleaned_sans_control_data.csv")

so that when the next file pulls "data/cleaned_control_data.csv" and "data/cleaned_sans_control_data.csv" they are the most recent
